reviewed_by: Codex focused control assistant work review
reason: The control assistant gains project-bound chat and mission tools while existing settings controls remain available. Cover provider and harness tool exposure, project isolation, queued follow-ups, start and interrupt actions, and remote Codex chat creation without implicit peer-message sharing. Cover work prompts, transcript persistence, validated Core receipts and client SSE normalization, then create and open a mission through the production bundle on a LAN-origin real Core with keyboard navigation on desktop and touch navigation in Chromium/WebKit phone profiles. The selected settings file also corrects its stale Docker-default assertion to the current Host policy.
exclusions: No native source or packaged shell changed. Full suites and unrelated settings, browser, notes, provider, mission, and workspace journeys are excluded. The real-Core model is a local deterministic stub; a live Codex harness is checked separately. Physical phone and software keyboard remain outside automated coverage.
